samples.title: Học chung nam nữ: ưu và nhược điểm
samples.focus: Strengths and weaknesses of mixed-gender education
samples.prompt: Examine the strengths and weaknesses of educating boys and girls together. Support your discussion with reasons and examples. Write at least 250 words.
requirementsVi: Phân tích cả ưu điểm lẫn nhược điểm của việc học chung.
Ví dụ phải liên quan đến lớp học nam nữ, không chỉ giáo dục nói chung.
Không đổi đề thành chỉ so sánh trường công và trường tư.

paragraphs.label: Đặt vấn đề
paragraphs.text: In many schools, boys and girls study in the same classrooms and take part in the same activities. This arrangement can prepare children for everyday life, but it also creates challenges that teachers need to manage. The main strengths of mixed education concern cooperation and equal opportunities, while its weaknesses may include social pressure and unequal participation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giới thiệu đúng hai mặt sẽ phân tích.

parts.text: In many schools, boys and girls study in the same classrooms and take part in the same activities. This arrangement can prepare children for everyday life, but it also creates challenges that teachers need to manage. The main strengths of mixed education concern cooperation and equal opportunities, while its weaknesses may include social pressure and unequal participation.

paragraphs.label: Ưu điểm có cơ chế và ví dụ
paragraphs.text: One important advantage is that students learn to work with people of another gender from an early age. For example, a mixed science project requires classmates to share equipment, discuss ideas and divide tasks. These experiences can make cooperation at university or work feel more natural later. Mixed schools can also challenge narrow ideas about what boys or girls should do. When a girl leads a robotics group or a boy performs well in literature, classmates can judge ability through real achievements rather than assumptions.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không khẳng định mọi lớp học chung đều bình đẳng; giải thích cơ hội tạo ra.

parts.text: One important advantage is that students learn to work with people of another gender from an early age.
For example,

a mixed science project requires classmates to share equipment, discuss ideas and divide tasks. These experiences can make cooperation at university or work feel more natural later. Mixed schools can also challenge narrow ideas about what boys or girls should do. When a girl leads a robotics group or a boy performs well in literature, classmates can judge ability through real achievements rather than assumptions.

paragraphs.label: Nhược điểm cụ thể
paragraphs.text: However, simply putting students together does not guarantee a comfortable learning environment. Some teenagers may avoid asking questions because they worry about being judged by classmates. Unequal expectations can also continue inside a mixed classroom. A teacher might, without intending to, ask boys to handle equipment and girls to take notes. If this happens repeatedly, students have fewer chances to develop different skills. Schools therefore need clear rules against teasing and should rotate responsibilities during group work instead of allowing the same children to lead every activity.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nhược điểm có tình huống cụ thể; giải pháp chỉ hỗ trợ phân tích.

parts.labelVi: Nêu ý đối lập hoặc giới hạn

paragraphs.label: Tổng hợp
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, educating boys and girls together offers useful preparation for social and working life and can widen opportunities. Nevertheless, social pressure and unfair classroom habits can limit these benefits. Its success depends on how teachers organise participation and respond when students feel excluded.

samples.title: Du lịch tác động đến cộng đồng địa phương
samples.focus: Positive and negative effects on residents
samples.prompt: Discuss how tourism affects local communities, considering favourable and unfavourable effects. Develop your points with reasons and examples. Write at least 250 words.
requirementsVi: Đối tượng trọng tâm là người dân và cộng đồng tại nơi đón khách.
Phân tích mặt tích cực và tiêu cực, mỗi mặt có ví dụ.
Không dành thân bài để kể lợi ích đi du lịch đối với bản thân du khách.

paragraphs.label: Xác định đối tượng
paragraphs.text: Tourism brings visitors into contact with places where other people live and work. For local communities, this can create valuable income and support public services. At the same time, a large number of visitors can put pressure on housing and the environment. Both effects deserve attention when a town decides how to develop its tourism industry.
paragraphs.noteVi: Trọng tâm là cộng đồng đón khách.

parts.text: Tourism brings visitors into contact with places where other people live and work. For local communities, this can create valuable income and support public services. At the same time, a large number of visitors can put pressure on housing and the environment. Both effects deserve attention when a town decides how to develop its tourism industry.

paragraphs.label: Tác động tích cực
paragraphs.text: On the positive side, visitor spending can support a range of local jobs. A family that opens a small guesthouse may buy vegetables from nearby farmers, hire a cleaner and recommend local guides. Money therefore reaches more people than just the owner of a hotel. Tourism can also give residents a reason to maintain traditional buildings or crafts. For example, income from guided visits to an old village could help pay for repairs, allowing both visitors and future generations of residents to enjoy it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu dòng tiền đến nhiều nhóm cư dân; ví dụ được đặt giả định bằng could.

paragraphs.label: Tác động tiêu cực
paragraphs.text: However, the benefits are not shared equally, and rapid growth can make daily life harder. If landlords convert ordinary flats into short-term accommodation, residents may struggle to find affordable homes. Busy streets, late-night noise and litter can also reduce the quality of life in a popular neighbourhood. A coastal community, for instance, may earn more from restaurants while facing extra rubbish on the beach. If public services do not grow with visitor numbers, local people have to deal with these problems throughout the holiday season.

samples.title: Có nên cấm hoàn toàn điện thoại ở trường?
samples.focus: A qualified position on school phone rules
samples.prompt: Some people believe secondary schools should ban students from bringing mobile phones onto school grounds. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Explain your position with reasons and examples. Write at least 250 words.
requirementsVi: Phân biệt cấm mang đến trường với cấm dùng trong giờ.
Lập trường nhất quán: phản đối lệnh cấm hoàn toàn, ủng hộ quản lý giờ dùng.
Hai lý do chính phải hỗ trợ lập trường này.
samples.summaryVi: Phân biệt cấm mang đến trường với cấm dùng trong giờ. → Lập trường nhất quán: phản đối lệnh cấm hoàn toàn, ủng hộ quản lý giờ dùng. → Hai lý do chính phải hỗ trợ lập trường này.

paragraphs.label: Lập trường rõ
paragraphs.text: Mobile phones can interrupt lessons, so it is understandable that some people want them removed from schools. However, I disagree with a complete ban on bringing them onto school grounds. Schools should control when phones are used, but students may still need them for travel arrangements and carefully planned learning activities. These needs are different from using a phone freely during class.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không đánh tráo cấm mang với hạn chế sử dụng.

parts.text: I disagree with a complete ban on bringing them onto school grounds. Schools should control when phones are used, but students may still need them for travel arrangements and carefully planned learning activities. These needs are different from using a phone freely during class.

paragraphs.label: Lý do về liên lạc
paragraphs.text: First, many secondary students travel to school without their parents. A phone allows a child to contact home if a bus is cancelled or an after-school activity finishes early. For example, a student who normally walks home with a friend may need to arrange a different way home when that friend is absent. School offices can help with emergencies, but they may not always be open when clubs finish. Allowing a switched-off phone in a bag gives families a practical way to deal with these changes.
paragraphs.noteVi: Ví dụ về thay đổi lịch trình, không phóng đại thành mọi tình huống nguy hiểm.

This does not mean that they should check messages during explanations. Repeated misuse could lead to the phone being kept safely in the school office until the end of the day.

samples.title: Học đại học trực tuyến hay tại trường?
samples.prompt: Some people think universities should offer most courses online to widen access. Others believe students learn better by attending classes on campus. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
requirementsVi: Giải thích vì sao mỗi phía có lý, không chỉ kể hai lựa chọn.
Nêu ý kiến riêng và phạm vi áp dụng.
Liên hệ hình thức học với nhu cầu sinh viên và môn học.
samples.summaryVi: Giải thích vì sao mỗi phía có lý, không chỉ kể hai lựa chọn. → Nêu ý kiến riêng và phạm vi áp dụng. → Liên hệ hình thức học với nhu cầu sinh viên và môn học.

paragraphs.label: Hai quan điểm
paragraphs.text: Universities can now teach students without requiring them to be in the same room. Supporters of online courses see this as a way to widen access, while others value learning on campus. Both views address real needs. In my opinion, universities should offer online access to suitable content while keeping regular opportunities for practical work and direct discussion.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu giải pháp kết hợp và giới hạn ngay đầu.

paragraphs.label: Lý do của phía trực tuyến
paragraphs.text: On the one hand, online courses can help people whose circumstances make daily attendance difficult. A student living far from a city may avoid the cost of renting a room near university. Recorded lectures can also be useful to someone who works shifts, because the material can be studied at another time. For example, a working parent might watch a lecture after putting a child to bed and submit questions before a scheduled discussion. Without this flexibility, that person might have to delay further study altogether.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích access bằng chi phí, nơi ở và thời gian.

Some subjects also require equipment that students cannot reasonably keep at home. A nursing student, for instance, needs supervised practice rather than only watching demonstrations on a screen. Campus study can therefore be particularly valuable for courses where feedback, teamwork and physical practice are central to learning.

samples.title: Ùn tắc giờ cao điểm: nguyên nhân và giải pháp
samples.focus: Private vehicles and unreliable public transport
samples.prompt: Traffic congestion during rush hour is a growing problem in many cities. Why does it happen, and what can local authorities do to reduce it? Give reasons and relevant examples. Write at least 250 words.
requirementsVi: Giải thích nguyên nhân ùn tắc, không chỉ tác hại.
Giải pháp do chính quyền địa phương thực hiện.
Mỗi giải pháp phải xử lý một nguyên nhân đã nêu.
samples.summaryVi: Giải thích nguyên nhân ùn tắc, không chỉ tác hại. → Giải pháp do chính quyền địa phương thực hiện. → Mỗi giải pháp phải xử lý một nguyên nhân đã nêu.

paragraphs.label: Nêu vấn đề
paragraphs.text: Traffic congestion makes daily travel slow and unpredictable in many cities. Although busy roads are often blamed on individual drivers, the problem is also connected with the choices available to commuters and the timing of everyday activities. Heavy dependence on private vehicles and concentrated travel times are two important causes that local authorities can address through transport planning.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hai nguyên nhân dẫn đường cho thân bài.

parts.text: Traffic congestion makes daily travel slow and unpredictable in many cities. Although busy roads are often blamed on individual drivers, the problem is also connected with the choices available to commuters and the timing of everyday activities. Heavy dependence on private vehicles and concentrated travel times are two important causes that local authorities can address through transport planning.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân thứ nhất và giải pháp
paragraphs.text: The first cause is that public transport may not be a practical alternative. If buses are infrequent, crowded or far from residential areas, people are more likely to drive even for journeys they make every day. For example, a worker who must change buses twice may choose a motorbike to avoid arriving late. Local authorities could improve routes connecting homes with major workplaces and give buses priority at busy junctions. Frequent, dependable services would make leaving a private vehicle at home a more realistic choice.

Local authorities could improve routes connecting homes with major workplaces and give buses priority at busy junctions. Frequent, dependable services would make leaving a private vehicle at home a more realistic choice.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân thứ hai và giải pháp
paragraphs.text: Another reason is that schools and offices often begin at similar times, concentrating many journeys into a short period. Roads near school gates can become especially crowded when parents stop to drop off children. Councils could work with schools and large employers to stagger starting times where possible. They could also create safe walking routes and organised drop-off areas away from the busiest junctions. These measures would not remove every vehicle, but they could spread demand and prevent a small blockage from delaying an entire street.

samples.title: Người trẻ rời quê lên thành phố
samples.focus: Reasons for migration and effects on rural communities
samples.prompt: Many young adults leave rural areas to live in cities. What are the main reasons for this movement, and how does it affect the rural communities they leave behind? Write an essay of at least 250 words with examples.
requirementsVi: Nêu lý do người trẻ chuyển đi.
Phần hệ quả tập trung vùng quê họ rời đi.
Không thay nửa bài bằng giải pháp phát triển thành phố.
samples.summaryVi: Nêu lý do người trẻ chuyển đi. → Phần hệ quả tập trung vùng quê họ rời đi. → Không thay nửa bài bằng giải pháp phát triển thành phố.

paragraphs.label: Giới thiệu
paragraphs.text: Moving to a city is an important decision for many young adults from rural areas. They often hope to study, find steady work or build a more independent life. While this movement can benefit individuals, it also changes the communities they leave behind. The main reasons concern education and employment, and the effects include both financial support and a loss of local workers.
paragraphs.noteVi: Xác định đúng nơi chịu tác động theo đề.

parts.text: Moving to a city is an important decision for many young adults from rural areas. They often hope to study, find steady work or build a more independent life. While this movement can benefit individuals, it also changes the communities they leave behind. The main reasons concern education and employment, and the effects include both financial support and a loss of local workers.

paragraphs.label: Nguyên nhân
paragraphs.text: One major reason is that universities and specialised training centres are often located in cities. A school leaver who wants to become an engineer may have few suitable courses close to home. Employment opportunities also influence the decision. Farming income can vary with the season, whereas a factory or office job may offer a more regular wage. Young people may therefore see moving as a way to support themselves and their families. Having friends or relatives already living in the city can make the move feel less uncertain.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hai nguyên nhân thực chất: học và việc làm.

paragraphs.label: Hệ quả ở quê
paragraphs.text: For rural communities, the effects are mixed. Money sent home can help parents pay bills, improve a house or keep younger children in school. A young worker might also return with useful skills and savings to start a business. However, when many people of working age leave, farms and local services may struggle to find staff. Older residents may have to manage physically demanding tasks without nearby family support. Shops can lose customers as well, making it harder for small businesses to survive throughout the year.

samples.title: Rác bao bì từ đồ ăn giao tận nhà
samples.focus: Problems caused by packaging and matching solutions
samples.prompt: Food delivery services often use large amounts of disposable packaging. What problems does this create, and what could businesses and customers do to reduce them? Write at least 250 words, supporting your ideas with examples.
requirementsVi: Phân tích vấn đề do bao bì dùng một lần gây ra.
Có hành động của cả doanh nghiệp lẫn người mua.
Không dành thân bài kể nguyên nhân người ta đặt đồ ăn.

paragraphs.label: Nêu vấn đề
paragraphs.text: Ordering food at home is convenient, but a single meal can arrive with several containers, bags and plastic utensils. When this happens across a city every day, the amount of disposable packaging becomes a serious practical problem. It increases the burden on waste collection and can pollute shared spaces. Businesses and customers both have ways to reduce unnecessary packaging.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không chuyển sang ưu nhược điểm của việc đặt đồ ăn.

parts.text: Ordering food at home is convenient, but a single meal can arrive with several containers, bags and plastic utensils. When this happens across a city every day, the amount of disposable packaging becomes a serious practical problem. It increases the burden on waste collection and can pollute shared spaces. Businesses and customers both have ways to reduce unnecessary packaging.

paragraphs.label: Tác hại
paragraphs.text: One problem is that takeaway packaging is not always easy to recycle. Containers covered in oil or sauce may need special cleaning, and several different materials can be used in the same order. This makes sorting more difficult for households and waste workers. Packaging that is not collected properly can also block drains or end up in rivers. For example, a thin plastic bag dropped near a street drain may be carried away during heavy rain, turning a small piece of litter into a problem beyond the customer’s neighbourhood.
paragraphs.noteVi: Tác hại có chuỗi giải thích, tránh khẳng định tất cả bao bì đều tái chế được.

For example,

paragraphs.label: Giải pháp hai phía
paragraphs.text: Businesses could start by making disposable cutlery optional instead of adding it automatically. A customer eating at home usually has a spoon already. Restaurants could also use fewer separate containers when food can safely be packed together. Where reliable washing and collection are available, a deposit system for reusable boxes may work for regular local customers. Customers, meanwhile, can refuse items they do not need, choose suitable collection options and follow local sorting instructions. Returning reusable containers promptly would help a deposit scheme continue operating.

samples.title: Nghỉ một năm trước đại học: lợi có lớn hơn hại?
samples.focus: Weighing experience against cost and lost study habits
samples.prompt: Some school leavers take a year to work or travel before entering university. Do the advantages of taking a gap year outweigh the disadvantages? Give a clear judgement and support it with reasons and examples. Write at least 250 words.
requirementsVi: Nêu bên nào có sức nặng hơn, không chỉ liệt kê.

paragraphs.label: Đánh giá tổng thể
paragraphs.text: A gap year gives school leavers time to work or travel before starting university. It can delay formal study and create financial difficulties, but it can also help young people make better decisions about their future. In my view, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages when the year has a realistic purpose and does not require the student to take on substantial debt.

paragraphs.label: Cân nhắc bất lợi

These costs are meaningful because the student still needs to complete a degree later. A gap year without a plan may therefore add stress rather than provide useful preparation.

samples.title: Internet có khiến thư viện công cộng hết cần thiết?
samples.focus: Public access, study space and help with information
samples.prompt: Because information is available online, some people say local governments should stop funding public libraries. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and relevant examples. Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs.label: Lập trường
paragraphs.text: The internet allows people to find information quickly, so it is reasonable to ask how public libraries should change. However, I disagree with the suggestion that local governments should stop funding them. Libraries provide access, space and guidance that an internet connection alone cannot guarantee. Their services may need updating, but this is a reason to improve public funding decisions rather than remove support entirely.

samples.title: Vì sao ít vận động và làm sao thay đổi?
samples.focus: Barriers for working adults and realistic daily habits
samples.prompt: Many working adults know exercise is useful but do little physical activity. What makes regular exercise difficult for them? What changes could they make to fit more activity into daily life? Write at least 250 words with examples.
requirementsVi: Đối tượng là người lớn đi làm.
Trả lời khó khăn và thay đổi do chính họ thực hiện.
Gợi ý khả thi với lịch làm việc; không thay bằng chính sách nhà nước.
samples.summaryVi: Đối tượng là người lớn đi làm. → Trả lời khó khăn và thay đổi do chính họ thực hiện. → Gợi ý khả thi với lịch làm việc; không thay bằng chính sách nhà nước.

paragraphs.label: Giới thiệu hai câu hỏi
paragraphs.text: Knowing that exercise is useful does not automatically make it part of a working adult’s routine. Long days, family responsibilities and unrealistic expectations can all make regular activity difficult. The most useful changes are often small ones that fit existing commitments. Adults may find it easier to become active by adjusting daily habits than by trying to copy a demanding training programme.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu đúng đối tượng và hướng giải quyết.

parts.text: Knowing that exercise is useful does not automatically make it part of a working adult’s routine. Long days, family responsibilities and unrealistic expectations can all make regular activity difficult. The most useful changes are often small ones that fit existing commitments. Adults may find it easier to become active by adjusting daily habits than by trying to copy a demanding training programme.

paragraphs.label: Khó khăn
paragraphs.text: Time is a major barrier. Someone who works all day and then prepares meals or cares for children may have little energy left for a journey to the gym. Cost and distance can add further obstacles. People may also think that exercise only counts if it lasts an hour or involves special equipment. For example, a worker who misses two planned gym sessions may decide that the whole week has been a failure. This all-or-nothing expectation can discourage an activity that could otherwise be continued in a simpler form.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không đổ lỗi chung là lười; phân tích thời gian và kỳ vọng.

For example,

a worker who misses two planned gym sessions may decide that the whole week has been a failure. This all-or-nothing expectation can discourage an activity that could otherwise be continued in a simpler form.

paragraphs.label: Thay đổi khả thi
paragraphs.text: A practical response would be to choose activities that require little preparation. A person could walk for part of the journey to work, take a short walk at lunchtime or do a brief exercise routine at home. Planning a specific time helps: a ten-minute walk after dinner is easier to remember than a general promise to exercise more. Involving family members can also turn activity into shared time rather than a competing responsibility. On a particularly busy day, reducing the length of the activity may be more sustainable than abandoning it completely.
